speaker_listener_roles_and_relationship: Use the known care recipient, care worker, colleague, supervisor, nurse, medical professional and family roles. Maintain the same speaker and listener in every turn and reporting instruction.
address_forms_and_conditions: Use respectful Burmese phrasing and ပါ / ရှင့် only where gender-independent register permits; primarily use ပါ and မလား. Omit unnecessary personal pronouns. Use the person's chosen name plus source さん when that precise address is the learning objective. Do not impose kinship terms or infantilizing address.
names_honorifics_and_unknown_gender_age: Retain original Japanese name spelling when no pronunciation is supplied. Do not infer gender, age, kinship or occupational status from a name. Preserve さん versus ちゃん when the distinction is taught; explain in Burmese.
register_and_social_phrases: Warm respectful adult speech; complete connected explanatory sentences. Requests explain the specific act and seek permission. Translate greetings and thanks according to their communicative function and the actual scene. Do not add care promises, treatment advice or new facts.
